name: defense_evasion_impact
description: An intruder covering their tracks: security logs emptied, shell history neutered at the source, and the at-job queue used for a delayed action. Each of these removes evidence rather than adding it, so the detections have to fire on ABSENCE — a log that exists and holds nothing, an rc file that disables recording. That is the hardest shape to test and the easiest to get quietly wrong.

plant.content:
# ir-lab
export HISTFILE=/dev/null
export HISTSIZE=0
set +o history

expect.id: an emptied auth log is FLAGGED as a wipe
an emptied syslog is FLAGGED as a wipe
history neutered in an rc file is FLAGGED
the rc file that disables history is collected verbatim
the shell history file is collected even when empty, with its size
